description: Check whether a study is running, analyzing, or complete while interviews are in progress. running and analyzing mean wait and call this again. Do not treat those payloads as findings. When status is complete, call get_study_results. The response includes interview_link and next_step. This does not return themes and it does not change the study. For a dry run before anyone is invited, call simulate_interview instead.
name: get_study_status
title: Get study status
